name: Commission proposal
title: Amending Directives (EU) 2022/2464 and (EU) 2024/1760 as regards the dates from which Member States are to apply certain corporate sustainability reporting and due diligence requirements ***I
part_text:
The proposal changes the deadline for completing a securities trade. Today, most trades on EU trading venues must be settled within two business days after the trade date. The proposal cuts this to one business day, known as T+1. It does not change which trades are covered. The aim is to match other major markets such as the United States, Canada, China and India, which already settle in one day, and to reduce risk and costs for investors.

- **What changes:** Settlement deadline for most trades on EU trading venues moves from two business days to one.
- **Who it affects:** Banks, funds, brokers and the depositories that settle securities trades in the EU.
- **What happens next:** The new rule would apply from 11 October 2027, giving the industry time to prepare.
